starter_files.contents:
# Personal Task Tracker

Run with `dotnet run`. Keep task state separate from prompts so it can be tested without console input.

## Done when

- [ ] Create and list tasks
- [ ] Mark a task complete or pending
- [ ] Filter pending tasks and sort by creation or title
- [ ] Persist records locally with validation
